brief.text: Real Madrid are still circling an Arsenal star as they plan a midfield move. Everything else is rumour, so treat it as maybe at best: Aston Villa chasing the same Bundesliga star, a Boca Juniors teenager on the radar, a priority new deal for a key man and a £285m question hanging over Man City's five-year plan. In the women's team, Renee Slegers says Olivia Smith is pain free and ready for more minutes, and she also gave updates on Mariona and Cerci's injuries and on Geraldine Reuteler's playing time. Nothing has reached "here we go" today.
